core_purpose_after_pivot: Establish a licensed, auditable real-GT benchmark for single-image/few-view head reconstruction before making any reconstruction-quality claim.
benchmark_acceptance_criteria: camera intrinsics and extrinsics for every selected view
foreground masks or reliable segmentation route
GT full-head mesh or point cloud
license/privacy status allows compact derived audit artifacts in repo
model/data distribution audit recorded before interpreting results

milestones.meaning: Benchmark-first pivot, route audit, and distribution gate are recorded.
Multiface debug compact case passes PASS_REAL_GT_BENCHMARK; repo records metrics, hashes, and a mask-only PNG while raw RGB/mesh remain local.
Old RI3D/evaluation adapter did not preserve Multiface real-camera assumptions.
Local-only Multiface adapter, z-buffer depth/conf, train/heldout split, and mask/depth-only audit figure pass.
CPU RI3D adapter file contract and local-only policy pass.
RI3D loads the adapter and saves a 67410-point initialization; no full training or quality claim.
Held-out render/eval executes from the G25 point cloud without saving identifiable media.
Tiny train10 reports NaN loss even under plain L1-only settings; longer training is blocked.

g22_preflight.meaning: G21 benchmark premise passes, but the old RI3D/evaluation adapter did not preserve Multiface per-view intrinsics, real-camera depth/conf priors, or held-out/mesh metrics.
